text: Over the last 30 days, visitors have frequently noted issues with crowding, which affected their ability to fully experience the exhibits and navigate the space comfortably. Several reviews mentioned confusion about timed entry and ticket purchasing, with some visitors unaware that tickets must be bought online in advance and others frustrated by payment restrictions. Parking was also a common concern, particularly regarding limited spaces taken up by large vehicles. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture, some criticized the heavy reliance on AI in the displays and the lack of clear directional signage inside. The gift shop received negative comments for its limited selection of library-related items.
